reconciliation: Sources equal uses; consideration less fair net assets equals book goodwill; modeled AGUB less other tax bases equals tax goodwill.

policy.basis_policy: Separate modeled adjusted grossed-up basis: $48M stock basis plus $20M recognized assumed liabilities, excluding $2.35M environmental/claim liabilities pending economic performance. Deduct $55M other tax asset bases to derive $13M tax goodwill independently of book goodwill. Finance leases are conditionally treated as tax-owned property with $2.5M basis; net AR tax basis aligns with its $6M book amount under the assumed specific disputed-debt treatment. Buyer transaction costs have zero modeled addition to target deemed-purchase basis; parent tax treatment is outside the group tax forecast. These classifications are conditional model assumptions, not a filed asset-allocation certificate.
policy.future_reserve_treatment: No ARU reserve settlement occurs in 2026. Future settlements require redetermined assumed-liability recognition, AGUB/asset allocation and tax amortization. The reserve DTA assumes eventual recovery through additional deductible basis, not an automatic immediate deduction on settlement.
policy.initial_goodwill_accounting: The $1.7625M initial book goodwill excess over tax basis is separately identified. No opening DTL is recognized for this initial excess under the modeled goodwill initial-recognition treatment. Subsequent tax amortization of the independent $13M basis creates a DTL. This is an explicit conditional accounting judgment, not an audited FASB conclusion.

ppa.deferred_tax_assumptions: Environmental/claim book accruals have no current deduction or included assumed-liability tax basis before economic performance. Settlement may increase deemed-acquisition asset basis recoverable through later tax amortization rather than create an immediate deduction. At the 25% scenario rate, full future DTA realization is assumed from positive forecast taxable income; no 2026 settlement/reversal of these ARU reserves. Other deemed-acquisition asset book/tax bases assumed aligned; debt issue costs amortized identically in this simplified scenario.
ppa.tax_basis_boundary: Synthetic book-tax step-up alignment is conditional on the tax memo; no audited deferred tax conclusion.
ppa.goodwill_method: Residual of consideration over disclosed fair identifiable net assets; not an operating income or cash plug.
